messages:
claire (product): Heads-up: MediCore wants a tight scope for Optimize alpha. Must include tenant-aware quant suggestions, nightly eval-triggered alerts on their clinical prompt set, and an auditable recommendation record. They explicitly forbid auto-rollouts. Can we triage scope?

josh (swe): For alpha I'd push API-only delivery (no UI). Target Dedicated eu-central to match their region. We can reuse eval-runner and alert-delivery libs. Estimate: 2 sprints for a small team.

priya (ml): ML proposal: sample 1500 clinical prompts, score baseline + candidate quant variants on entity-F1 and ppl, compute latency tradeoffs, surface top-2 quant profiles with estimated p50/p95/p99. Trigger rules: entity-F1 drop >=2% OR ppl+latency win combo.

kate (solutions): Customer requirement: every alert must create an audit record with baseline_eval_id, new_eval_id, recommended_quant, metric_deltas, and a 1-2 sentence rationale. They need this for compliance review.

claire (product): Proposed alpha acceptance criteria: nightly eval job runs and stores metrics; alert emitted within 10m when trigger fires and delivered to internal ops + customer webhook + email; audit record persisted; tenant opt-out respected; docs + runbook available.

josh (swe): Agreed. Implementation notes: short-lived feature flag per tenant, config to disable delivery, and a single API endpoint that emits JSON alerts. No auto-apply.

priya (ml): I'll prepare the eval set and baseline hashes. For the payload we'll include metric_deltas and a short rationale sentence. Example JSON payload will be included in the ticket.

kate (solutions): I'll draft customer-facing wording that clarifies "advisory only" and prepare onboarding checklist. MediCore will be our anchor pilot.

claire (product): Quick prioritization: customers with compliance needs get alpha seats. Approve alpha scope (API-only recommendations + nightly eval alerts + audit log + opt-out)? React in-thread with :white_check_mark: / :x:.

josh (swe): :white_check_mark:

priya (ml): :white_check_mark:

kate (solutions): :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Branch created: feature/optimize-mediCore-alpha. CI started.

claire (product): Next steps: Josh open eng ticket with acceptance criteria (today); Priya upload eval set and hashes (48h); Kate prepare customer note (EOD); I'll schedule kickoff with MediCore. If no objections we convert to tickets.
